constraints.con.tip.lock_length: Keeps this wall at its current length on every edit
constraints.con.tip.lock_dist: Keeps the distance between the two walls on every edit
constraints.con.tip.equal: Keeps the steps between the selected walls equal
constraints.con.tip.align: Keeps both walls on one line
constraints.con.tip.perp: Keeps the walls at a right angle
constraints.con.tip.align_grid: Keeps the wall on the nearest grid line
constraints.con.tip.lock_dist_grid: Keeps the distance from the wall to the nearest grid line
constraints.con.tip.level_gap: Keeps the gap between the levels
constraints.con.tip.top_to_level: Keeps the top of the wall at the level above
